_readme: HOW TO ADD AN ANIMAL TO THE WALL
When someone sends the form on memorial.html, the message arrives in your email.
Nothing appears on the site until you add it here, so you always get the last word.
Add one entry to the 'entries' list below:
id     (required) a short unique tag, e.g. 'bella-2024'. Never reuse or change it,
because it is what keeps a visitor's lit candle attached to the right animal.
name   (required) the animal's name
years  (optional) e.g. '2011 - 2024'
words  (optional) what the person wrote, in their words
from   (optional) the person's name, e.g. 'the Nguyen family'
photo  (optional) path to a file you saved in assets/img/memorial/
alt    (optional) short plain description of the photo, for screen readers
EXAMPLE
"name": "Bella",
"words": "She met me at the door every single day for thirteen years.",
"from": "Sam",
"photo": "assets/img/memorial/bella.jpg",
"alt": "A tan terrier asleep in a patch of sun"
Newest first. Delete this _readme block whenever you like.
